historical.primary: ospa30; all allowed references; natural and synthetic Semi separately described
historical.weighting: each block unit total standardized squared distance; not each raw axis equal
historical.fit: task-adjusted effects independently per axis; target building excluded from every block
historical.fairness: all methods use same training-qualified workers for common-panel predictions; native coverage separately reported
historical.replay: all prespecified methods; q=.95 and OSPA30<=6; point count hard constraint; 200 without-replacement orders; future>=5
historical.half_support_sensitivity: Primary 6 responses/3 buildings remains; additional half diagnostic uses 3 responses/2 buildings because OOS has 9 images. Report separately, not as replacement.
historical.replay_horizons: 7,8,10,13 and available arm n>=7; H13 permits checking k8; compare only same images and H; two pure types, balanced alternating MIX, ALL

group_count_extension.group_count_range: 2 through floor(eligible workers / 2); singleton outputs preserved, not validated types
group_count_extension.primary: existing audited primary axes, native eligibility, equal information block weight
group_count_extension.algorithm: Ward unchanged; variable group count; no balanced-size constraints or retrospective merging
group_count_extension.caveat: No new convergence replay or quality prediction; capacity is a data sufficiency audit, not convergence evidence

current_group_count_rule: 2 through floor(training-qualified workers/2); retain singleton groups, no forced balance
current_worker_policy: Retain W011 history; exclude W019/W026 main; old all26/current20 are historical cohorts only
reuse_policy: Use historical candidate definitions; refit within current training split. Whole-dataset memberships are descriptive only.
